profiles.label: Baker Bear
profiles.prompt: A warm, calm adult bakery owner. Speak gently, clearly, and reassuringly with cozy storybook warmth.
profiles.soundDesign: Warm chest resonance with a soft storybook bass.
profiles.text: A calm bakery is my favorite kind of magic.

profiles.label: Bunny
profiles.prompt: A bright, high-pitched, cheerful bunny voice. Energetic but easy for children to understand.
profiles.soundDesign: Springy bright pitch with quick, clean articulation.
profiles.text: Which pastry gets the most sprinkles around here?

profiles.label: Dog
profiles.prompt: An upbeat, loyal, friendly dog. Speak with excited warmth, like a happy friend whose tail is wagging.
profiles.soundDesign: Happy tail-wag energy with a tiny excited wobble.
profiles.text: I brought my biggest tail wag for this visit!

profiles.label: Frog
profiles.prompt: A cheerful French frog. Warm, playful, and easy to understand.
profiles.soundDesign: Croaky throat resonance, gentle ribbit tremolo, and damp low tone.
profiles.text: Ribbit! Hello, baker! I hopped in for a delicious little treat!

profiles.label: Elephant
profiles.prompt: A warm Indian elephant with a huge appetite and a helpful trunk.
profiles.soundDesign: Huge rounded body resonance with soft, gentle lows.
profiles.text: I never forget a bakery that smells this wonderful.

profiles.label: Giraffe
profiles.prompt: A graceful, polite, light adult voice. Elegant and friendly with careful, clear diction.
profiles.soundDesign: Tall, airy brightness with elegant upper clarity.
profiles.text: The view of the pastry case is excellent from up here.

profiles.label: Hedgehog
profiles.prompt: A small, shy, soft-spoken hedgehog. Gentle and slightly hesitant, then warmly pleased.
profiles.soundDesign: Tiny shy pitch with soft edges and light breathiness.
profiles.text: This cozy corner is just right for my little paws.

profiles.label: Capybara
profiles.prompt: An extremely relaxed Brazilian capybara. Calm and friendly.
profiles.soundDesign: Extra-mellow low warmth with sleepy rounded highs.
profiles.text: Whatever you bake is fine with me. I am happy to relax.

profiles.label: Lion
profiles.prompt: A rich, regal lion voice with friendly theatrical confidence. Proud but never scary.
profiles.soundDesign: Regal bass, broad presence, and a tiny room-filling roar tail.
profiles.text: A magnificent bakery deserves a magnificent appetite!

profiles.label: Leopard
profiles.prompt: A smooth, confident, quick leopard voice. Cool, playful, and precise.
profiles.soundDesign: Sleek fast clarity with a bright, precise feline edge.
profiles.text: I spotted that pastry from all the way across the room.

profiles.label: Tiger
profiles.prompt: A bold, playful tiger voice with energetic confidence and a friendly rumble.
profiles.soundDesign: Punchy feline rumble with energetic growly lows.
profiles.text: That striped cookie looks like it was made for me!

profiles.label: Deer
profiles.prompt: A gentle, graceful woodland deer voice. Soft, musical, and welcoming.
profiles.soundDesign: Musical woodland lightness with a faint open-air echo.
profiles.text: The bakery feels as peaceful as a sunny forest clearing.

profiles.label: Moose
profiles.prompt: A big, kind French-Canadian moose. Slow, warm, and gentle.
profiles.soundDesign: Very deep rustic resonance with a broad friendly chest tone.
profiles.text: I hope my antlers fit beneath the bakery lights today.

profiles.label: Crocodile
profiles.prompt: A friendly Australian crocodile with a big grin. Relaxed and welcoming.
profiles.soundDesign: Low reptile rasp with slow swampy throat modulation.
profiles.text: Do not worry, baker. I only snap at delicious cookies.

profiles.label: Red Squirrel
profiles.prompt: A tiny, high-pitched, very quick squirrel voice. Excited and curious, but still understandable.
profiles.soundDesign: Maximum tiny squeak, rapid chatter, and excited vibrato.
profiles.text: Cookies, crumbs, and cozy chairs? This place has everything!

profiles.label: Panda
profiles.prompt: A soft, sleepy panda voice. Quiet, sweet, relaxed, and comforting.
profiles.soundDesign: Pillow-soft sleepy warmth with gently rolled-off highs.
profiles.text: Mmm, this bakery is almost as cozy as a long nap.

profiles.label: Owl
profiles.prompt: A wise, polite British owl. Clear and gently fussy.
profiles.soundDesign: British scholarly bass with a subtle library-room resonance.
profiles.text: A most thoughtful selection of pastries, if I may say so.

profiles.label: Pig
profiles.prompt: A bubbly, delighted pig voice. Cheerful, expressive, and full of friendly giggles.
profiles.soundDesign: Bouncy high oink-like brightness with playful flutter.
profiles.text: Oh, what a perfectly sweet little bakery!

profiles.label: Penguin
profiles.prompt: A crisp, cheerful penguin voice. Polite, brisk, bright, and playfully formal.
profiles.soundDesign: Crisp icy brightness with neat, clipped articulation.
profiles.text: A warm pastry is exactly what this chilly penguin needs.

profiles.label: Red Panda
profiles.prompt: A warm, playful red panda voice. Youthful, fluffy, lively, and friendly.
profiles.soundDesign: Youthful fluffy brightness with a subtle playful wobble.
profiles.text: This bakery has excellent snacks and excellent fluffy vibes!
